I am an Associate Professor of Kinesiology at INEFC Lleida and, since 2022, I have
coordinated the centre's research support.

Many measurements strike me as more convincing than reliable. That is the thread through
everything I work on: how we measure what exercise does to the body, and what we can claim
from what we have measured.

I currently lead EXCURSE (2025–2028), a project examining how muscle excursion range during
strength training shapes adaptation. It is funded by INEFC under reference 2025 PINEF 00018
and co-led with Xavier Peirau Terès.

My other work examines the validation of field tests for endurance performance, and cardiac
biomarkers after exercise in children and adolescents. Applied biostatistics runs through
all three lines: time-course modelling, Bayesian regression, systematic review and
meta-analysis.

I am recruiting doctoral candidates to work within EXCURSE from late 2026.
[Read about the PhD opportunity](phd.qmd).
